scope: Read-only static audit of fixed EXP-004 source; no training or cloud execution. Exact hidden-run optional-member activation requires logs/input tree.

source.line_convention: comp_py_lines are 1-based extracted comp_stack.py lines, notebook cell8 source line minus 1 because %%writefile is removed

execution.FAST_COMMIT: cell2 line15: len(test.csv)<50; comp_stack executed only when false
execution.SMOKE: Only when NTL_SMOKE==1; not set by standard runner
execution.outer_weight_evidence: notebook cell12 line20; final combination handled by infer.py
execution.pipe_note: cell10 uses !python ... | grep -vE Warning|warn and does not explicitly propagate python status; no failure inferred for completed submission

external_loader.order: listed pattern order; lexicographically sorted matches within each pattern; first duplicate survives
steps: For ntl_generations.csv keep finish_reason==stop when field exists; for ntl_generated*.csv keep finish==stop when exists
Rename model or label; retain only prompt_id/model/text, discarding settings, route, source_prompt_id, source etc
Prefix only passages_clean.csv prompt_id with pv_; other banks keep their strings
Strip text, remove whole-text **wrapper** when regex matches, collapse whitespace (no NFKC/casefold)
Keep prompt groups with >=12 distinct labels
risk_notes: Same prompt+model repeated with different settings is reduced to first occurrence, so file order affects retained setting
Only prvs gets namespace prefix. Metadata discarded before filtering, so unknown bank collisions cannot be disambiguated
train_regen source_prompt_id discarded; adding this loader to a local held-out prompt experiment requires explicit lineage filter
No explicit external-vs-heldout prompt exclusion; current formal full-train use is not thereby shown invalid

limitations: All runtime-fitted dense heads here use official train only, but this does not establish what pretrained encoders or adapters already saw
Weights are log-probability multipliers, not percentages; family gate lambdas are not ordinary member blend weights
LORA checkpoint metadata and producer training manifests are not read by this consumer script
Optional q35 cannot truthfully be called disabled by NTL_DROP_Q35=1 in this frozen version
